title: Opportunistic Risk Assessment of Major Osteoporotic Fractures from Routine Chest Radiographs Using Deep Learning
zh_title: 深度学习从常规胸片机会性评估骨质疏松性骨折风险
summary: 在5.3万例成人中开发卷积神经网络生存模型，用常规胸片预测主要骨质疏松性骨折，并在两家独立机构8.5万例中外部验证。
key_points: 开发队列53,109人，外部验证85,284人来自两家独立机构
以胸片影像构建CNN生存模型，主要结局为新发主要骨质疏松性骨折
用C-index与AUROC评估区分度，针对骨量减少区间风险识别盲区
入组要求胸片与双能X线吸收法检查间隔1年内，均属被转诊人群
reason: 大样本且两家独立机构外部验证，属重要档；回顾性设计、未报告临床结局改善故不上调
abstract: Background Bone mineral density (BMD) and the Fracture Risk Assessment Tool (FRAX) incompletely capture fracture risk in the osteopenic range, where much of the fracture burden occurs. Routine chest radiographs are acquired across a broad range of patients and may contain information relevant to fracture risk, offering a potential opportunistic complement without additional imaging burden. Methods We developed a convolutional neural network survival model in 53,109 adults at a tertiary hospital and externally validated it in 85,284 patients from two independent institutions. Eligibility required a chest radiograph obtained within 1 year of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry scans, so all participants had been referred for densitometry. The primary outcome was incident major osteoporotic fracture. Discrimination was assessed by using the concordance index (C-index) and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) at 2, 3, 5, and 10 years, compared with FRAX with BMD and with the lowest BMD T-score. Results In the external validation cohorts (mean 58.6 years of age; 68.9% female; and follow-up of 77 months), the deep-learning (DL) model achieved a C-index of 0.843 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.837 to 0.850) and a censoring-adjusted 10-year AUROC of 0.855 (95% CI, 0.846 to 0.863), which was higher than that of FRAX with BMD (C-index, 0.779, 95% CI, 0.770 to 0.787; 10-year AUROC, 0.785, 95% CI, 0.775 to 0.794; both P Conclusions A survival DL model applied to routine chest radiographs identified patients at high fracture risk with discrimination exceeding that of FRAX, with the greatest benefit in patients with osteopenia. As all participants had been referred for densitometry, absolute-risk and case-finding estimates require prospective evaluation in an unselected routine-radiography population. (Funded by the National Research Foundation of Korea and others.).
zh_abstract: 【背景】骨密度（BMD）和骨折风险评估工具（FRAX）不能完全捕捉骨量减少范围内的骨折风险，而大部分骨折负担发生在该范围内。常规胸部X线片在广泛患者人群中获取，可能包含与骨折风险相关的信息，提供一种潜在的机会性补充，而不增加额外影像负担。【方法】我们在53,109名三级医院成人中开发了一种卷积神经网络生存模型，并在来自两个独立机构的85,284名患者中进行了外部验证。纳入资格要求胸部X线片在双能X线吸收测定扫描前1年内获取，因此所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定。主要结局为新发主要骨质疏松性骨折。通过使用一致性指数（C-index）以及2年、3年、5年和10年的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估判别能力，并与联合BMD的FRAX以及最低BMD T值进行比较。【结果】在外部验证队列中（平均年龄58.6岁；女性68.9%；随访77个月），深度学习（DL）模型达到C-index为0.843（95%置信区间[CI]，0.837至0.850）以及经删失校正的10年AUROC为0.855（95% CI，0.846至0.863），高于联合BMD的FRAX（C-index，0.779，95% CI，0.770至0.787；10年AUROC，0.785，95% CI，0.775至0.794；两者均P）【结论】应用于常规胸部X线片的生存DL模型识别出高骨折风险患者，其判别能力超过FRAX，在骨量减少患者中获益最大。由于所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定，绝对风险和病例发现估计需要在未选择的常规放射摄影人群中进行前瞻性评估。（由韩国国家研究基金会等资助。）

title: Interpretable AI links routine clinical gout phenotypes to multi-omic signatures and divergent health trajectories
zh_title: 可解释AI将痛风临床表型与多组学及健康轨迹关联
summary: 用常规实验室变量无监督分型，并在英国生物银行、中国GoutRe与MIMIC-IV三个队列外部评估。
key_points: 21,235人数据，含两个外部独立队列
识别三种痛风亚型，复发与死亡风险不同
C2亚型复发风险显著高于C1
reason: 跨三国多队列外部验证且样本过万，符合重要档加分项。
abstract: Integrative frameworks that connect scalable clinical phenotypes with molecular mechanisms are needed to resolve disease heterogeneity. We developed and externally evaluated an interpretable gout clinical-subset framework using routine data from 21,235 participants across UK Biobank (UKB; n = 10,599), the multicentre Chinese GoutRe registry (n = 8617), and MIMIC-IV (n = 2019). Unsupervised learning on six prespecified routine laboratory variables identified three subsets: C1, a low-burden state with preserved reserve; C2, a urate-metabolic inflammatory state with the greatest recurrence liability and a greater cardiometabolic and hepatic comorbidity burden; and C3, a state characterized by systemic vulnerability and higher mortality. In UKB, death-competing recurrence analysis showed a higher recurrence incidence for C2 versus C1 (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR] 1.896, 95% CI 1.710–2.101), whereas C3 did not differ from C1 (sHR 0.994, 95% CI 0.887–1.112). A six-variable CRT model reconstructed the locked subset labels using nested 10-fold out-of-fold evaluation in UKB and external application without retraining in GoutRe and MIMIC-IV. One-versus-rest AUCs were 0.965/0.945/0.980 in UKB, 0.906/0.914/0.953 in GoutRe, and 0.912/0.898/0.962 in MIMIC-IV for C1/C2/C3, respectively. Genetic, proteomic, and metabolomic analyses supported distinct urate-inflammatory and systemic-vulnerability axes, although the C3 senescence-related genetic signal was nominal and requires replication. Routine laboratory data can identify gout clinical subsets with distinct molecular profiles and patterns of recurrence and mortality; whether these subsets can guide clinical management requires prospective evaluation.
zh_abstract: 需要将可扩展的临床表型与分子机制联系起来的整合性框架，以解析疾病异质性。我们利用来自21,235名参与者的常规数据开发并外部评估了一个可解释的痛风临床亚组框架，这些参与者来自UK Biobank（UKB；n = 10,599）、多中心中国GoutRe注册研究（n = 8617）和MIMIC-IV（n = 2019）。对六个预先指定的常规实验室变量进行无监督学习，识别出三个亚组：C1，一种储备保留的低负担状态；C2，一种尿酸盐代谢炎症状态，具有最高的复发风险以及更大的心脏代谢和肝脏合并症负担；C3，一种以全身脆弱性和更高死亡率为特征的状态。在UKB中，以死亡为竞争风险的复发分析显示，C2与C1相比复发发生率更高（亚分布风险比[sHR] 1.896，95% CI 1.710–2.101），而C3与C1无差异（sHR 0.994，95% CI 0.887–1.112）。一个六变量CRT模型在UKB中使用嵌套10折折外评估重建了锁定的亚组标签，并在GoutRe和MIMIC-IV中不重新训练进行外部应用。C1/C2/C3的一对多AUC在UKB中分别为0.965/0.945/0.980，在GoutRe中分别为0.906/0.914/0.953，在MIMIC-IV中分别为0.912/0.898/0.962。遗传学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学分析支持不同的尿酸盐-炎症轴和全身脆弱性轴，尽管C3的衰老相关遗传信号仅为名义性（nominal），需要重复验证。常规实验室数据可以识别具有不同分子谱以及复发和死亡模式的痛风临床亚组；这些亚组能否指导临床管理需要前瞻性评估。

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled clinical decision support: device regulation and decision influence.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: AI临床决策支持：器械监管与决策影响力
summary: 评述FDA 2026年1月临床决策支持指南，指出AI赋能的CDS可能加剧临床医生的自动化偏差。
key_points: 讨论FDA 2026年1月CDS指南的豁免逻辑
AI生成或转换信息难以在常规诊疗中核验
提出将务实触发条件纳入现有治理框架
reason: 针对FDA最新指南的监管分析观点文，有信息量但非实证研究，属值得一看档。
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled clinical decision support (CDS) challenges core assumptions of the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) recently updated CDS guidance, including the concepts of independent clinician review of outputs and manufacturer-intended use for exempting certain CDS tools from medical device regulation. We examine the FDA's January 2026 CDS guidance in the context of the evolving landscape of AI-enabled CDS tools, clinician interaction studies with AI-enabled CDS, and AI governance frameworks. Although the FDA's framework distinguishes non-device CDS from regulated software, AI-enabled CDS may synthesize and transform clinical information in ways that are difficult to verify during routine care, increasing clinician susceptibility to automation bias. Incorporating pragmatic triggers into existing governance frameworks can help identify scenarios with a heightened risk for clinical decision influence. Oversight calibrated to real-world clinical decision influence is needed to strengthen practical safety standards for AI-enabled CDS.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 人工智能（AI）赋能的临床决策支持（CDS）对食品药品监督管理局（FDA）最近更新的CDS指南的核心假设提出挑战，包括对输出进行独立临床医生审查的概念，以及制造商预期用途可使某些CDS工具豁免医疗器械监管的概念。我们在AI赋能CDS工具不断演变的格局、临床医生与AI赋能CDS交互研究以及AI治理框架的背景下，审视FDA 2026年1月的CDS指南。尽管FDA的框架将非器械CDS与受监管软件区分开来，但AI赋能CDS可能以在常规诊疗中难以核实的方式综合和转换临床信息，增加临床医生对自动化偏倚的易感性。将务实触发因素纳入现有治理框架，有助于识别临床决策影响风险升高的情景。需要根据现实世界临床决策影响进行校准的监督，以加强AI赋能CDS的实用安全标准。

title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
zh_title: Breath-Dx：电子鼻疾病筛查时间序列基准
summary: 预印本发布Breath-Dx基准，基于1234例九类诊断的公开电子鼻数据，系统评测时间序列分类并量化传感器漂移。
key_points: 首个呼气疾病筛查时间序列分类基准
1234例、17通道、九诊断组公开数据
显式时间划分量化传感器漂移
reason: 公开大规模电子鼻数据集与系统基准，属重要档；预印本需谨慎。
abstract: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. We systematically evaluate 10 methods spanning four families: feature-based tabular learners, convolution-based models, graph-based, and time series architectures. All methods degrade significantly under temporal validation (0.05-0.12 AUC drop compared to random cross-validation), confirming that drift embeds a strong temporal signal. Under this realistic evaluation, the best methods achieve ROC AUC of 0.74-0.76 for some lung conditions, though others remain near chance. Recurrent architectures show the most consistent performance across diseases, while specialized time series methods achieve the highest peak results. Demographic confounders matter: breath signals provide independent diagnostic value for some conditions but add little beyond age for others. We release the S-OH dataset, all temporal splits, evaluation protocols, and code to enable reproducible research and accelerate progress in clinical breathomics.
zh_abstract: 电子鼻（eNose）技术通过呼出气分析为疾病筛查提供了一种便携、非侵入性的途径。然而，该领域的进展受到阻碍，因为缺乏在现实条件下比较机器学习方法的系统性基准，尤其是传感器漂移——一种已知但很少被量化的失效模式。大多数现有研究依赖小型私有数据集且方案不一致，导致结果不可比较并减缓进展。我们推出 Breath-Dx，这是首个用于基于呼吸的疾病筛查的时间序列分类方法的综合基准。我们的工作利用 Scent of Health（S-OH）数据集，这是迄今最大的公开临床 eNose 集合，包含九个诊断组的 1,234 名患者，每位患者提供 17 通道多变量时间序列，并具有考虑传感器漂移的显式时间训练/测试划分。我们系统评估 10 种方法，涵盖四个类别：基于特征的表格学习器、基于卷积的模型、基于图的方法和时间序列架构。所有方法在时间验证下均显著退化（与随机交叉验证相比 AUC 下降 0.05-0.12），证实漂移嵌入了强时间信号。在这种现实评估下，最佳方法对某些肺部疾病达到 ROC AUC 0.74-0.76，而其他疾病仍接近随机水平。循环架构在跨疾病中表现最一致，而专门的时间序列方法达到最高峰值结果。人口学混杂因素很重要：呼吸信号对某些疾病提供独立诊断价值，但对其他疾病在年龄之外几乎没有增加信息。我们发布 S-OH 数据集、所有时间划分、评估协议和代码，以实现可重复研究并加速临床呼吸组学进展。

title: Clinician Acceptance of Large Language Model-Generated Discharge Summaries.
zh_title: 临床医生对LLM生成出院摘要的接受度
summary: JAMA Network Open发表5家伦敦医院回顾性研究，以非劣效框架比较LLM与医生撰写的出院摘要的临床接受度。
key_points: 5家伦敦医院2022-2023年入院记录
预设非劣效框架比较临床接受度
LLM出院摘要对比医生撰写摘要
reason: 同行评审多中心回顾性比较，评估临床接受度并有外部医院数据，属重要档。
abstract: [JAMA network open] Hospital discharge summaries are essential for continuity of care, but fragmented electronic health record (EHR) data can compromise their quality and safety. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for clinical documentation tasks despite limited evidence regarding their performance in health care settings compared with the current standard of care. To evaluate clinician acceptability of LLM-generated discharge summaries derived from EHRs compared with routine clinician-written summaries. In this retrospective comparative effectiveness study using a prespecified noninferiority framework, acceptability of LLM-generated discharge summaries was compared with clinician-authored discharge summaries. Admission records from 5 London hospitals for September 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, were evaluated against the full admission record by practicing physicians. Admissions were eligible only if the clinician-authored discharge summary contained identifiable clinical summary, plan and requested actions, and information given sections. Data analysis was conducted from July 2025 to February 2026. LLM-generated summaries were produced using GPT-4o mini (July 18, 2024 release; OpenAI) and a clinician-codesigned prompt. The primary outcome was clinician signoff with no or minor edits, derived from 2 sequential questions: (1) whether the reviewer would sign the summary and (2) whether no, minor, or major edits were required. A 5-percentage-point noninferiority margin was prespecified. The study sample included 1294 (649 clinician-authored and 645 LLM-generated) unique case discharge summaries that were evaluated against the full admission record by 12 practicing physicians. zh_abstract: [JAMA network open] 医院出院小结对于照护连续性至关重要，但碎片化的电子健康记录（EHR）数据可能损害其质量和安全性。大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被提出用于临床文书任务，尽管关于其在医疗保健环境中相较于当前标准照护的表现证据有限。旨在评估临床医生对源自EHR的LLM生成出院小结相较于常规临床医生撰写出院小结的接受度。在这项采用预先指定非劣效性框架的回顾性比较有效性研究中，将LLM生成出院小结的接受度与临床医生撰写的出院小结进行比较。来自5家伦敦医院2022年9月1日至2023年9月30日的入院记录由执业医师对照完整入院记录进行评估。仅当临床医生撰写的出院小结包含可识别的临床摘要、计划与请求的行动以及已告知信息部分时，入院病例才符合纳入条件。数据分析于2025年7月至2026年2月进行。LLM生成的小结使用GPT-4o mini（2024年7月18日发布；OpenAI）和由临床医生共同设计的提示词生成。主要结局为临床医生在无编辑或轻微编辑下签署，该结局由2个连续问题得出：（1）审阅者是否会签署该小结；（2）是否需要无编辑、轻微编辑或重大编辑。预先设定5个百分点的非劣效界值。次要结局评估准确性、完整性、语气和清晰度（使用5点Likert量表：1，差；2，一般；3，好；4，很好；5，优秀）以及缺失或错误信息的潜在危害性（使用5点Likert量表：1，无危害；2，轻微危害；3，中度危害；4，高度危害；5，极高危害）。研究样本包括1294份（649份临床医生撰写，645份LLM生成）唯一病例出院小结，由12名执业医师对照完整入院记录进行评估。病例患者的中位年龄为46.0岁（IQR，26.2-69.8岁），733名（56.6%）出生时指定为女性，中位住院时间为3.0天（IQR，1.0-7.0天）。无编辑或轻微编辑后签署的模型估计概率绝对差（LLM生成减临床医生撰写）为22.2个百分点（95% CI，19.0-27.5个百分点）；下限超过预先设定的非劣效界值 -5 个百分点

title: Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning
zh_title: 物理引导自监督从CBCT检出MRI验证软组织病变
summary: 预印本用物理引导3D自监督学习，在212对颞下颌关节CBCT-MRI上从常规CBCT提取亚视觉软组织病变信号。
key_points: 212对颞下颌关节CBCT-MRI数据
冻结3D掩码自编码器预训练6550例CBCT
探索常规影像机会性软组织筛查
reason: 新方法但样本小、单一模型系统且无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.
zh_abstract: 常规 X 射线模态如锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）针对高对比度矿化组织进行优化，使软组织异常埋没在光子噪声之下并低于人类视觉感知。因此，检测非钙化病变需要二次磁共振成像（MRI）。我们证明，软组织病变的亚视觉放射学特征在物理上保留于常规 CBCT 扫描中，并且即使在配对数据极度稀缺的情况下，也可使用有针对性的、物理引导的深度学习流程提取用于机会性筛查。以颞下颌关节（TMJ）作为模型系统（N = 212 对 CBCT-MRI 关节），我们通过两阶段框架解决高容量 3D 网络的严重过拟合。首先，我们采用冻结的全网格 3D 掩码自编码器（BertsWin），通过 GradientConductor（GCond）优化器和解剖感知目标（PhysLoss）在 6,550 个未标注 CBCT 体积上预训练，该目标将梯度流重定向到 [-300, 300] HU 软组织窗。其次，髁突顶点的自动定位驱动确定性 3D 裁剪，消除 81% 的背景骨性方差。通过患者隔离的 3x10 折分层交叉验证方案评估，MRI 证实的滑膜积液的统计稳健亚视觉信号（ROC AUC = 0.793）仅从使用 PhysLoss 和 GCond 方案预训练的表征中出现。关键的是，只有这种设置能捕获真正的 3D 解剖手性（p < 0.001）和高患者内结构一致性（0.791）而非患者间噪声；相反，使用标准 L2 损失或未掩码方差分解（MVC）预训练的相同架构退化为随机猜测。这些发现建立了一个可推广的范式，将常规低对比度放射学扫描重新用于隐匿性软组织疾病的机会性筛查工具。

title: Human-Agentic AI Collaboration Workflow for Trend Analysis of ChatGPT Applications in Healthcare
zh_title: 人-智能体协作分析ChatGPT医疗应用趋势
summary: medRxiv预印本用LLM智能体与领域专家协作，系统检索并分析ChatGPT在医疗健康中的应用研究趋势。
key_points: 系统检索PubMed与Web of Science
LLM智能体与领域专家协作分析
聚焦ChatGPT医疗应用与相关关切
reason: 预印本综述，智能体协作方法有新意但无原始临床验证。
abstract: Background: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have demonstrated strong potential to transform healthcare research and practice. However, LLMs are probabilistic and generate inherently variable outputs, which create risk and uncertainty in healthcare applications. Therefore, analyzing the current research landscape of ChatGPT applications is imperative to understand applied techniques and related concerns and to facilitate their practical integration into healthcare information systems. Objective: Leveraging LLM-based agentic AI with domain experts to analyze trends in ChatGPT healthcare applications and to examine the collaborative and interpretative capacities of LLM agents in broader contexts beyond narrowly defined topics. Methods: The review used a systematic search of the PubMed and Web of Science databases, following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, and focused on ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors. To support the review process, an adaptive, iterative LLM-based agentic AI with a human-in-the-loop mechanism was employed for automated metadata extraction, identification, classification, and knowledge synthesis. The extracted information was subsequently used for temporal and thematic analyses, citation network construction, and main-path analysis. Results: Across 192 papers, the review identified 511 ChatGPT application types, 690 concern items, and 368 influence usage factors distinct from traditional IT, achieving a metadata error rate of 1.04%. The human-agentic AI workflow enabled efficient synthesis of contextual information across studies, addressing the growing challenge of timely evidence integration in medical knowledge. The findings provide insights into the evolving trajectories of ChatGPT applications in healthcare and demonstrate the value of an expert-validated human-agentic AI workflow in supporting literature analysis and streamlining review processes. Conclusion: This review provides a comprehensive overview of emerging ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors in healthcare. The study further provides meaningful insights into the operational mechanisms of agentic AI, demonstrating the potential of human-AI collaboration for medical informatics research.
zh_abstract: 【背景】随着人工智能（AI）的快速发展，大型语言模型（LLM），如 ChatGPT，已展现出改变医疗保健研究与实践的强大潜力。然而，LLM 具有概率性并产生内在可变输出，这在医疗保健应用中带来风险和不确定性。因此，分析 ChatGPT 应用的当前研究格局至关重要，以理解所应用的技术和相关关切，并促进其实际整合到医疗保健信息系统中。【目的】利用基于 LLM 的代理式 AI 与领域专家一起分析 ChatGPT 在医疗保健应用中的趋势，并考察 LLM 代理在狭义主题之外的更广泛情境中的协作与解释能力。【方法】本综述对 PubMed 和 Web of Science 数据库进行系统检索，遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南，聚焦于 ChatGPT 应用、相关关切、应用技术和使用因素。为支持综述过程，采用具有人在回路机制的自适应、迭代式基于 LLM 的代理式 AI 进行自动化元数据提取、识别、分类和知识综合。提取的信息随后用于时间与主题分析、引文网络构建和主路径分析。【结果】在 192 篇论文中，本综述识别出 511 种 ChatGPT 应用类型、690 个关切断面和 368 个区别于传统 IT 的影响使用因素，元数据错误率为 1.04%。人类-代理式 AI 工作流能够高效综合跨研究的上下文信息，应对医学知识中及时证据整合日益增长的挑战。研究结果提供了对 ChatGPT 在医疗保健中应用演变轨迹的洞见，并证明了经专家验证的人类-代理式 AI 工作流在支持文献分析和简化综述流程方面的价值。【结论】本综述全面概述了医疗保健中新兴的 ChatGPT 应用、相关关切、应用技术和使用因素。该研究进一步提供了对代理式 AI 运行机制的有意义洞见，展示了人-AI 协作在医学信息学研究中的潜力。

title: Multimodal LLM for Breast Cancer Radiotherapy Target Auto-Contouring and Planning
zh_title: 多模态大模型用于乳腺癌放疗靶区自动勾画与计划

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Xiaohui Zhao; conditions: Breast Cancer, Radiotherapy; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 51000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Breast cancer remains the most prevalent malignancy among women worldwide, with a continuously increasing incidence. As a crucial component of comprehensive cancer treatment, radiotherapy plays a key role in reducing local recurrence rates and improving overall survival outcomes. However, traditional radiotherapy target volume contouring and treatment planning design rely heavily on clinician expertise, presenting challenges such as prolonged processing time, significant inter-observer variability, and high subjectivity in dose optimization. Although artificial intelligence has made substantial progress in automated contouring and planning, conventional single-modal models still face major limitations. These models struggle to effectively integrate clinical text, tumor biological characteristics, and dose distribution factors, resulting in restricted generalizability. Therefore, developing an intelligent radiotherapy assistance system capable of multimodal data fusion is of high clinical significance to enhance precision and efficiency in breast cancer radiotherapy. This study aims to develop an innovative breast cancer radiotherapy assistance system based on a multimodal large language model. By integrating multimodal imaging data (including CT, MRI, and ultrasound), pathology reports, and structured electronic health record text, the system realizes end-to-end intelligence from target volume contouring to treatment plan generation. Employing a multicenter, ambidirectional cohort design, the study collects comprehensive clinical data from breast cancer patients who have undergone breast-conserving surgery or mastectomy. Technologically, the system innovatively combines the natural language processing capabilities of large language models with the image analysis strengths of deep learning, utilizing attention mechanisms to achieve deep fusion and interactive comprehension of heterogeneous medical data. Notably, the system breaks through traditional radiotherapy planning workflows by jointly optimizing target contouring and dose planning as a unified pipeline, applying reinforcement learning algorithms to dynamically balance target volume coverage with organ-at-risk protection. The outcomes of this study will provide an important paradigm for the clinical application of AI in radiation oncology and advance the field of precision radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Xiaohui Zhao；疾病/条件：乳腺癌、放疗；类型：观察性；入组人数：51000；状态：尚未招募] 乳腺癌仍是全球女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤，且发病率持续上升。作为综合癌症治疗的重要组成部分，放疗在降低局部复发率和改善总生存结局方面发挥关键作用。然而，传统放疗靶区勾画和治疗计划设计严重依赖临床医生经验，存在处理时间长、观察者间变异大以及剂量优化高度主观等挑战。尽管人工智能在自动勾画和计划方面取得实质性进展，传统单模态模型仍面临重大局限。这些模型难以有效整合临床文本、肿瘤生物学特征和剂量分布因素，导致泛化能力受限。因此，开发能够进行多模态数据融合的智能放疗辅助系统，对于提高乳腺癌放疗的精准性和效率具有高度临床意义。本研究旨在开发一种基于多模态大语言模型的创新性乳腺癌放疗辅助系统。通过整合多模态影像数据（包括CT、MRI和超声）、病理报告和结构化电子健康记录文本，该系统实现从靶区勾画到治疗计划生成的端到端智能化。研究采用多中心、双向性队列设计，收集接受保乳手术或乳房切除术的乳腺癌患者的综合临床数据。在技术上，该系统创新性地将大语言模型的自然语言处理能力与深度学习的图像分析优势相结合，利用注意力机制实现异构医学数据的深度融合和交互理解。值得注意的是，该系统突破传统放疗计划工作流程，将靶区勾画和剂量计划作为统一流程进行联合优化，应用强化学习算法动态平衡靶区覆盖与危及器官保护。本研究的结果将为AI在放射肿瘤学中的临床应用提供重要范式，并推动精准放疗领域发展。

title: Automated segmentation of renal structures using brightfield images of unstained kidney biopsies
zh_title: 未染色肾活检明场图像的肾结构自动分割
summary: bioRxiv预印本综述未染色肾活检明场显微图像的分割方法，探讨减少染色依赖并保留组织用于分子分析。
key_points: 聚焦未染色肾活检明场图像分割
综述现有分割方法与技术挑战

abstract: The automated segmentation of unstained kidney brightfield microscopy images remains a significant challenge in medical imaging. In conventional histopathology, staining provides crucial structural and molecular contrast, allowing renal compartments and structures to be readily distinguished. The absence of staining markedly reduces this contrast, obscuring the fine architectural details that are essential for diagnosis. Addressing this gap would reduce reliance on staining protocols, reduce technical and interpretive variability, and preserve valuable tissue for downstream molecular or multi-omics analyses. Ultimately, automation of unstained image segmentation could enable faster, more objective tissue analysis while preserving samples for further molecular testing. In this work, we provide a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art segmentation methods applied to renal brightfield microscopy images. Current findings highlight a predominance of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based architectures for semantic segmentation approaches while recent trends point to the growing application of transformer-based and instance-segmentation strategies. However, the field is still hampered by the scarcity and poor annotation of publicly available renal datasets. Aiming to further contribute to the enhancement of the field, a dataset of 18 Whole Slide Images (WSIs) of unstained human kidney tissue is made publicly available. Additionally, in the dataset, we provide 543 annotated tiles extracted from the WSIs, facilitating further research into stain-independent segmentation approaches. As a third contribution, we present a preliminary case study, evaluating state-of-the-art deep learning segmentation architectures, including U-Net and Segment Anything Model (SAM). Our preliminary results indicate that deep learning models demonstrate promising segmentation performance in unstained kidney biopsies. In alignment with these findings, advanced customised loss functions and data augmentation were integrated into the supervised training of the promising U-Net, DeepLabv3+, and TransUNet models, achieving significant improvements compared to the baseline experiments. To exploit the abundance of unlabelled data, we further tested FixMatchSeg, a semi-supervised learning method; however, its segmentation performance remained slightly behind the supervised methods. Taken together, these contributions establish a foundation for future research in stain-independent Computationa
zh_abstract: 无染色肾脏明场显微镜图像的自动分割仍然是医学成像中的重大挑战。在传统组织病理学中，染色提供关键的结构和分子对比度，使肾区室和结构易于区分。缺乏染色显著降低这种对比度，模糊诊断所必需的精细结构细节。解决这一差距将减少对染色方案的依赖，减少技术和解释变异性，并为下游分子或多组学分析保留宝贵组织。最终，无染色图像分割的自动化可以促成更快、更客观的组织分析，同时保留样本用于进一步分子检测。在本工作中，我们全面综述应用于肾脏明场显微镜图像的最先进分割方法。当前发现强调，语义分割方法以卷积神经网络（CNN）架构为主，而近期趋势表明基于 transformer 和实例分割策略的应用日益增多。然而，该领域仍受公开可用肾脏数据集稀缺和标注质量差的阻碍。为进一步促进该领域发展，我们公开提供一个包含 18 张无染色人肾组织全切片图像（WSI）的数据集。此外，在该数据集中，我们提供从 WSI 中提取的 543 个标注图块，促进对不依赖染色的分割方法的进一步研究。作为第三项贡献，我们呈现一个初步案例研究，评估最先进的深度学习分割架构，包括 U-Net 和 Segment Anything Model（SAM）。我们的初步结果表明，深度学习模型在无染色肾活检中展现出有前景的分割性能。与这些发现一致，先进的定制损失函数和数据增强被整合到有前景的 U-Net、DeepLabv3+ 和 TransUNet 模型的监督训练中，与基线实验相比取得显著改善。为利用大量未标注数据，我们进一步测试了半监督学习方法 FixMatchSeg；然而，其分割性能仍略落后于监督方法。综上所述，这些贡献为无染色计算病理学的未来研究奠定了基础。
